Q6111.reason: A general litter ordinance is a content-neutral O'Brien regulation of conduct that protects park cleanliness and only incidentally burdens symbolic speech.

Q5735.reason: Only a defendant may remove; the plaintiff's removal was unauthorized, so the defendant's timely remand motion sends the whole case back.

Q5651.reason: Advertising the car as a 1964 is an express warranty of description that an as-is clause cannot disclaim under UCC 2-316.
